name: yt-dlp (download)
description: Download video/audio from the web via yt-dlp. The {INPUT} placeholder is the source URL (paste a URL as the input). Output is written next to the cockpit project. Respect copyright and site terms of service.

presets.name: Extract audio → MP3
presets.description: Download and extract best audio as MP3 (great for feeding whisper next)

presets.name: Download video → MP4
presets.description: Download best video+audio, merged to MP4

presets.name: Download video ≤720p → MP4
presets.description: Cap resolution at 720p to save space/bandwidth

presets.name: Download subtitles (SRT)
presets.description: Fetch subtitles (manual + auto-generated) as SRT, no media download

presets.name: Info (JSON metadata)
presets.description: Dump video metadata as JSON without downloading
